name: Yatra Online Ltd
title: Yatra Online Ltd - 543992 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Yatra's Q4 FY26 was hit by West Asia conflict: EBITDA fell 46% YoY to INR 126m as MICE bookings were cancelled or deferred, though FY26 adjusted EBITDA grew 37.5% to INR 917m and management says Q1 run-rate is about 20% above Q4.

triggers.label: Q4 MICE bookings cancelled or deferred
triggers.quote: Several Q4 MICE and international travel group bookings were either cancelled or deferred into FY27.

triggers.label: Q1 run-rate ~20% above Q4
triggers.quote: we are already seeing signs of recovery with Q1 run rates currently trending approximately 20% above Q4 levels.

triggers.label: Hotel realisation down on mix
triggers.quote: our average realisations per room night has dropped

triggers.label: Q1 FY27 muted, H2 expected stronger
triggers.quote: Q1, given that we've already seen two months of the quarter play out, would remain a bit muted.

guidance.quote: we remain confident of our medium-term growth CAGR of revenue-less service cost of 20% and adjusted EBITDA of 30%.
We are saying that model remains constant.
we want to get to a high teens kind of number when it comes to ROCE

prior_guidance_check.quote: RLSC performance was ahead of our revised guidance of 22% in F Y26.
Adjusted EBITDA of INR 917 million, year on year growth of 37.5% came in line with revised guidance

red_flags.label: Receivables and working capital stretch
red_flags.quote: congrats on improving your work ing capital receivable days

red_flags.label: Hotel discount-to-gross ratio up to ~48%
red_flags.quote: the gross, the discounting we give as a percentage of the gross take rate has increased

evasions.quote: it's not as simple to just, you know, do a segmental reporting for us
we don't call out our advertisement revenue separately
